title: Psychedelic Fox Portrait
description: A surreal black and white line drawing of a classical bust with a lightning bolt across the face, one eye crying red poppies while the other is a hypnotic spiral. A vibrant green and blue fox with geometric patterns and a tie-dye tail emerges from the mouth, melting downward. The background features a dramatic sunset over plowed fields, floating colorful puzzle pieces, and large stylized flowers at the top.
prompt: Surreal symbolic portrait of a classical Greek-style bust rendered in black and white line art against a black background. A white lightning bolt cuts across the face. One eye cries streams of red poppies, the other contains a green hypnotic spiral. A vibrant green fox with geometric patterns melts from the mouth, its body transitioning into blue and red tie-dye. Colorful puzzle pieces float throughout the composition. Top of image has large stylized blue, white, and purple flowers. Bottom shows a dramatic orange and purple sunset over plowed black fields.
